themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to housing, social services, and public resources. This theme appears in Spain (Vox), Italy (Fratelli d'Italia/Lega), Sweden (Sverigedemokraterna), and Norway (Fremskrittspartiet), reflecting a shared transnational narrative of protecting national identity and welfare systems from perceived external threats.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands 'national priority' in housing, healthcare, and social aid, framing it as a defense against immigrant exploitation of public services. The party has tabled motions in regional parliaments (Andalusia, Valencia) and city councils (Seville, Cartagena) to enforce these policies, often clashing with coalition partners like PP.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia advocate for policies that prioritize Italian citizens in welfare and housing, with Lega threatening unilateral action if EU budget rules block energy subsidies for families. The coalition has also pushed for stricter immigration controls, aligning with the broader 'national priority' narrative.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats oppose resource redistribution to vulnerable areas, arguing it undermines national cohesion and increases child criminality. Their stance on school policies and housing reflects a broader push to prioritize Swedish citizens in public services.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party's proposals for motor traffic laws and local governance reforms emphasize national sovereignty and reduced bureaucracy, aligning with the 'national priority' theme by advocating for policies that benefit Norwegian citizens over external interests.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN criticizes 'punitive ecology' policies in housing and opposes the 2050 Zero Net Artificialisation goal, framing these as threats to French citizens' quality of life. The party also advocates for stricter immigration controls, reinforcing the 'national priority' narrative.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces growing disapproval and internal conflicts within his government, with approval ratings dropping and key allies clashing over policy directions. This theme resonates in Spain (Vox), the US (MAGA/Trump), Italy (Fratelli d'Italia/Lega), and France (Rassemblement National), where Milei’s leadership is closely watched as a bellwether for right-wing governance.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's approval rating has dropped to historic lows (58.3% disapproval in May 2026), with internal conflicts between factions led by Karina Milei, Patricia Bullrich, and Luis Caputo. The government faces criticism over austerity measures, job losses, and stalled reforms, while Milei’s confrontational style alienates allies and the public.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has distanced itself from Milei’s government, criticizing its economic policies and internal divisions. The party’s leader, Santiago Abascal, has publicly questioned Milei’s leadership, reflecting broader skepticism among European right-wing parties about his radical approach.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump officials have praised Milei’s reforms, but US right-wing media and analysts highlight his declining popularity and internal strife as a cautionary tale. The Trump administration’s support for Milei is tempered by concerns over his ability to govern effectively amid growing opposition.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties monitor Milei’s struggles as a test case for radical economic policies. While some in Fratelli d'Italia admire his deregulation efforts, others in the coalition, like Lega, view his austerity measures as politically unsustainable and a warning against similar policies in Italy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN has expressed mixed views on Milei, with some members admiring his anti-establishment rhetoric while others criticize his economic policies as too extreme. The party’s leadership sees Milei’s struggles as a lesson in the risks of radical governance, particularly in maintaining public support.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties are making significant gains in local and regional elections across Europe, reshaping political landscapes and challenging traditional parties. This theme is evident in Italy (Fratelli d'Italia/Lega), Spain (Vox), Germany (AfD), Sweden (Sverigedemokraterna), and France (Rassemblement National), where far-right parties are consolidating power at the municipal and regional levels.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Fratelli d'Italia and Lega secured key victories in local elections in Venice and Reggio Calabria, boosting the national government’s political standing. The coalition’s success reflects broader right-wing momentum in Italy, with Fratelli d’Italia leading in national polls and Lega consolidating its regional base.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has made gains in regional and municipal elections, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla y León, where it has formed coalition governments with the PP. The party’s focus on 'national priority' policies and anti-immigration rhetoric has resonated with voters, though internal divisions and defections threaten its stability.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD has surged in state polls, particularly in Saxony-Anhalt (41%) and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, where it is poised to become the largest party in upcoming elections. The party’s gains reflect growing dissatisfaction with mainstream parties, though its extremist ties and internal scandals continue to spark controversy.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats have consolidated their position as the leading right-wing party, influencing national policy on immigration and welfare. The party’s success in local elections, such as in Sandviken, reflects its growing appeal among voters disillusioned with the Social Democrats and Moderates.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN has made significant gains in local elections, particularly in southern France, where it has positioned itself as a credible alternative to traditional parties. The party’s focus on security, immigration, and anti-EU rhetoric has resonated with voters, though its leader, Marine Le Pen, faces potential ineligibility in the 2027 presidential race.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, leadership struggles, and defections, undermining their cohesion and electoral prospects. This theme is evident in Poland (PiS), Hungary (Fidesz/Tisza), the UK (Reform UK), France (Rassemblement National), and Italy (Fratelli d'Italia/Lega), where infighting threatens party unity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces growing internal divisions over leadership and strategy, with factions led by Jarosław Kaczyński and President Karol Nawrocki clashing over judicial appointments and party direction. The party’s struggles reflect broader challenges in maintaining unity ahead of the 2027 elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz is grappling with internal dissent following its election defeat, with former leaders like Tibor Navracsics suggesting a return to 1998 values. The Tisza Party, led by Péter Magyar, has capitalized on Fidesz’s divisions, positioning itself as a reformist alternative and gaining traction in polls.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces internal splits over immigration policy and leadership, with figures like Nigel Farage and Robert Jenrick clashing publicly. The party’s infighting threatens its electoral prospects, particularly in the Makerfield by-election, where it risks splitting the right-wing vote.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN is navigating internal tensions over its 2027 presidential candidate, with Marine Le Pen potentially barred from running due to a fake jobs scam ruling. The party’s leadership has appointed Julien Sanchez as campaign director to manage the transition, but divisions persist over strategy and messaging.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Italian right-wing coalition faces internal divisions, particularly over Ukraine’s EU accession, with Lega opposing the move and Fratelli d’Italia supporting it. The coalition’s unity is further tested by leadership struggles, such as the competition between Vannacci and Calenda for the 2027 mayoral elections.

themes.title: AfD’s extremism and EU-wide backlash
themes.blurb: Germany’s Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces growing scrutiny and backlash over its extremist ties, with calls for bans at the national and EU levels. This theme resonates in Germany, where mainstream parties and civil society groups are mobilizing against the AfD, and in broader European networks, where the party’s alliances are under threat.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD risks an EU-wide ban due to its extremist ties, with the European Public Prosecutor’s Office investigating its alliance in the European Parliament. The party faces protests, legal challenges, and exclusion from committee leadership roles in state parliaments, reflecting broader backlash against its far-right agenda.

countries.name: 🇪🇺 Transnational Networks
countries.note: The EU is moving to ban AfD’s far-right alliance, the Europe of Sovereign Nations, citing violations of EU values such as anti-migrant, antisemitic, and anti-LGBT statements. This reflects a broader effort to counter far-right extremism at the transnational level.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN faces scrutiny over its ties to far-right extremism, particularly in the context of its alliance with AfD in the European Parliament. The party’s leadership has sought to distance itself from AfD, but its extremist rhetoric continues to draw criticism and legal challenges.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces allegations of Islamophobia and extremism, with 27 MPs calling for an investigation into the party’s rhetoric and policies. The party’s internal divisions and controversial statements have sparked backlash, particularly in the context of its electoral campaigns.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz’s extremist ties and authoritarian governance have drawn criticism from the EU, with Hungary’s new Tisza government seeking to distance itself from past controversies. The party’s efforts to join the European Public Prosecutor’s Office reflect its attempts to navigate EU scrutiny while maintaining its far-right agenda.
